summary: Tested the new genre browser, PWA assets/registration, playable genre cards, cast/person exploration, and mobile regression against the live app.

integration_issues.issue: One browser run left person-modal present after Escape; the person-close button and known-for handoff passed, so Escape behavior is intermittent and needs retest.

action_items: Retest Escape handling when PersonModal is open over PlayerModal; ensure it consistently closes the person modal without leaving an unexpected overlay.
seed_data_creation: None; no persistent seed or user data was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Genre Action chip/grid/clear passed on Discover and Movies; TV genre list rendered expected TV categories; genre card opened FrameXTV iframe; person photo/name/bio/read-more/known-for grid passed; known-for card closed person and opened player; close button passed. Manifest, service worker, both icons, registration, no service-worker console errors, absent install button, /api/, and 390px overflow passed. Escape close had one inconsistent failure.
rca of the issue: The app registers Escape listeners independently in PlayerModal and PersonModal while both overlays can coexist. In one run the PersonModal remained after Escape despite its window listener; direct close and known-for state transitions worked. Investigate event ordering/state batching or reproduce with a focused Escape test.
